        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("Disbursement Date")) AS year,

    FROM shg_loan_register
    WHERE "Source" = 'Block MIS export'

SELECT
    t1.year AS year,
    t1.total_loan_amount AS total_loan_amount,
    (t1.total_loan_amount - t2.total_loan_amount) / NULLIF(t2.total_loan_amount, 0) * 100 AS percentage_growth
FROM yearly_totals t1
LEFT JOIN yearly_totals t2 ON t1.year = t2.year + 1
WHERE t1.year = 2024 OR t2.year = 2023
ORDER BY t1.year;
